name: snapper-mcp
description: Connects Claude Code / Claude Desktop to a Snapper trading backend via the /api/mcp endpoint.

SNAPPER_BASE_URL.title: Snapper API URL
SNAPPER_BASE_URL.description: Your Snapper backend MCP endpoint, e.g. https://snapper.example.com/api/mcp - generate from Snapper's AI Integration settings page.

SNAPPER_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Access token
SNAPPER_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: JWT or long-lived PAT. Paste from Snapper's AI Integration config-snippet generator. Auto-refreshed when paired with a refresh token (see below).

SNAPPER_REFRESH_TOKEN.title: Refresh token (optional - leave blank for long-lived PAT delegates)
SNAPPER_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Long-lived JWT for auto-rotation. Paste for rotating-token delegates. LEAVE BLANK for delegates minted with long_lived=true (single ~10-year access token, no refresh).
